text:
alex: Pushing canary for payments-service chart 3.5.0 to cluster-prod-canary at 12:30 PT. Main change is values schema -> `payments.enabled_features` nested object + bump of CPU requests (250m->400m). Watch for CPU and readiness.

maria: noted. tagging @sre for canary watch. any migration steps?

alex: no DB migrations, just values shape change. We shipped a small compatibility shim, but old pod may log about missing keys for a minute.

deploy-bot: deploy started: helm upgrade --install payments-canary ./charts/payments --version 3.5.0 --values canary-values.yml --namespace canary (release: payments-canary, rev: 42)

jordan: seeing initial replicas healthy. CPU trending up to ~60% of node (was ~30%). Could be the new default thread pool.

samir: link to dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd/payments?orgId=1&from=now-5m to=now — CPU spike aligned with roll.

maria: can we temp reduce requests in values to 300m and reapply? or should we rollback to 3.4.0?

alex: prefer non-rollback if it's a harmless perf change, but latency p95 is creeping. current p95 +25ms. If it keeps growing we should rollback.

sre-bot: health-gate check failed: p95_latency > 20ms threshold for 3 consecutive windows. auto-fallback not enabled for this release.

jordan: +1 to rollback. pods also have increased OOMKilled events on one host (possibly packing).

alex: ok starting rollback to pinned chart 3.4.0 and old values. Running:
```
helm rollback payments-canary 41 --namespace canary
kubectl rollout status deploy/payments-canary -n canary
```

deploy-bot: rollback initiated: helm rollback payments-canary 41 (target rev: 41)

maria: after rollback, let's pin chart version in the release values and add a preflight that checks node allocatable CPU headroom. Filed ticket: RH-4672 to add preflight.

samir: +1. also suggest adding a lightweight smoke test that hits /health and checks a sample trace for latency.

alex: agreed. For now I added a quick patch to chart values: `chartVersion: 3.4.0` in release config and pushed a `canary-protections` flag off so auto-fallback will remain manual until we have a proper policy.

sre-bot: rollback complete. rollout status: success. p95 back to baseline.

jordan: thanks all. follow-up items: pin chart on the pipeline, add preflight CPU headroom check, and add a canary runbook note about values-schema changes.

maria: I'll update release notes and callout the known CPU request change so apps/infra teams can opt in when ready. :memo: 

alex: closing this thread. Will reopen if we try 3.5.0 again with mitigations. :white_check_mark:
